Wright and Le Corbusier were designers, not primarily urban analysts in the structuralist sense. Colin Rowe and Fred Koetter's Collage City (1978) as applying 'structuralist urban analysis...examined how cities themselves operate as systems of meaningful relationships rather than collections of individual buildings.' This structuralist approach proved productive for understanding actual cities.
